name: Antigravity IDE
description:
Google Antigravity IDE is the dedicated integrated development environment designed around Google DeepMind's agentic AI coding assistant. It delivers an AI-native pair programming workspace that combines powerful code editing with autonomous agent-driven development workflows.

Features:
- Agent-first editor interface optimized for interactive collaboration with AI
- Built-in multi-turn task planner, artifact review, and visual progress tracking
- Deep workspace context awareness with real-time code indexing and diagnostics
- Integrated terminal, diff reviewer, and automated change applicator
- Extensible via custom skills, MCP tools, and personalized engineering rules
